headlines.text: Back on this day in 2022, Adam Page vs. Lance Archer fought tooth and nail for the AEW World Heavyweight Title in a Texas Death Match, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.50 ? a war that left everything in the ring. A bloody, brutal Texas Death Match, with the fight spilling backstage before the bell even rang ? Page threw Archer through a pane of glass and finally won with a Buckshot Lariat through a stack of tables, on the same show that saw Keith Lee's shock signing.
Turning the clock back to 2024: Undisputed Kingdom & Strong made their AEW debut as a team, appearing on Rampage, rated 6.00.
On a Wednesday in 2022, back when Moxley & Punk arrived in AEW as a team, appearing on Dynamite, rated 8.21 ? one of the better matches of the year.

secondaries.text: Rewind to 2022, when The Blade returned to the fold after just under 3 months away, appearing on Dynamite.
That Wednesday in 2022, AQA touched down in AEW for the first time against Jade Cargill, appearing on Dynamite, rated 3.69.
Looking back to 2024, when Mistico vs. Matt Sydal met for the very first time on Rampage, rated 5.78.
